Recovery functions and operations

F14 ManageFaults detects and latches modeled fault conditions.
O08 LandAndSecure uses a scripted three-second touchdown delay.
O10 SafeState keeps motors inhibited on the ground.
F18 SuperviseMission accepts an explicit reset after healthy readiness signals.
O02 Commissioning → O05 PrepareFlight restores readiness; automatic reflight remains inhibited.

Mission events and check results

MSN-EDU: educational flight and data delivery, achieved through O01–O09. Each event records the procedure, model configuration and scenario trace. The table tracks both procedure results and mission completion.
